trail.text: Wrote the article 'What Is ARFID? How It Presents in Adults' (blog post 1 of the September ARFID plan, retitled to this action item): content-drafts/action-items-2026-10-21/arfid-what-it-is-and-how-it-presents-draft.md, with a Word copy beside it (ARFID article draft for Sara 2026-10-21.docx). Byline Sara Hamilton, PsyD.

Every BCC claim follows Sara's October 6 answers on 'RE: ARFID page: a few details to confirm': ARFID only alongside an obesity component, inside the IOP; no clinician described as ARFID trained (Sara: none of us); adults 18 and older; telehealth across Texas with no in-person part; referral for low weight, high rigidity or heavy accommodations, with no provider named.

Gmail draft from daniel@drbdig.com to Sara, cc Todd: 'ARFID article for your edits: what it is and how it presents' (article inline so she can edit in red; offers a Word copy). It also asks Todd whether to hold the article until staff ARFID training, which Sara raised on October 6.
Nothing placed on staging14 or anywhere else.

steps.do: Read and send the Gmail draft 'ARFID article for your edits: what it is and how it presents'. If Sara would rather edit in Word, attach the .docx beside the draft.
